metadata.note: Derived game massing, not survey-grade reconstruction. Flat ground; connected-part minimum base datum; upper-envelope podium/tower silhouettes. Road clearance 3.5m beyond authored carriageways including the Cross-Harbour surface approaches, plus 2m within 32m of the Nathan/Granville bus turn; authored park omitted. Missing heights use storeys x 3.2m or 9.6m. Facades are generated artwork, not surveyed photographs. Base datums are reconciled across all five Kowloon extracts before regional clipping; duplicate BuildingCSUID records share one group. TopHeight and fallback Storeys use the newest retrieved_utc record per BuildingCSUID (original undated extract: 2026-09-13 UTC; ties prefer Kwai Chung, northwest, west, north, original). Each region retains its own source footprint and OBJECTID.
